# Indicators

The 21 indicators every experiment, Monte Carlo run and script reports, as the engine defines them (`METRICS` in the script API). Each is computed from the run itself at its end; "per year" figures divide by the years the run lived.

An experiment reports each one per arm, over its seeds, and as a **paired effect** against the baseline with a 95% interval. *Better* is the direction counted as an improvement in "better in k of n seeds"; an indicator marked *neither* is reported without a direction.

An indicator a run cannot estimate is reported as missing (—), and the seeds where it is missing are left out of its effect: life expectancy, for instance, needs at least three deaths of each sex.

## Demography

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `population` | Residents at the end | people | neither | People living in the province on the last day. |

## Health

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deaths_per_1000` | Deaths per 1,000 a year | ‰ | lower | Deaths over the run per 1,000 person-years lived (the crude death rate). |
| `ae` | Deaths: actual / expected | × | neither | Deaths over the run against the expected deaths on the basis, age by age and day by day (pooled A/E). |
| `e0` | Life expectancy at birth | years | higher | The basis table scaled by the run's own A/E for each sex; men and women averaged. |
| `u5mr` | Under-five deaths per 1,000 births | ‰ | lower | Deaths of children under five over the run per 1,000 births over the run. |
| `hospital_per_1000` | Hospital admissions per 1,000 a year | ‰ | lower | Clinic-ward and central-hospital admissions per 1,000 person-years. |

## Insurance

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scheme_reserve` | Burial society reserve at the end | R | higher | The society's reserve on the last day (nominal rand). |
| `scheme_ruin` | Burial society ruined | 0/1 | lower | 1 if the reserve went below zero during the run (its mean over seeds is the probability of ruin). |
| `loss_ratio` | Claims / premiums | × | lower | Claims paid over the run against premiums received. |
| `funeral_cover` | Households with funeral cover | share | higher | Share of households holding funeral cover on the last day. |

## Equity

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `poverty` | Households in poverty (last year) | share | lower | Share of households below the poverty line, averaged over the last twelve month-ends. |
| `gini` | Income Gini (last year) | index | lower | Gini coefficient of household income, averaged over the last twelve months. |

## Economy

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unemployment` | Unemployment (last year) | share | lower | Unemployment rate, averaged over the last twelve months. |
| `gdp_per_capita` | Real GDP per resident (last year) | R | higher | Real GDP over the last twelve months (start-of-run prices) per resident. |
| `inflation` | Inflation, a year on average | share | lower | Annualised growth of the province's CPI over the run. |
| `household_debt` | Household debt at the end | R | lower | Sum of households' debt on the last day. |
| `household_savings` | Household savings at the end | R | higher | Sum of households' savings on the last day. |

## The fiscus

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tax_revenue` | Tax revenue a year | R | neither | Taxes collected over the run, per year. |
| `grant_spend` | Social grants a year | R | neither | SASSA child-support and older-persons grants paid over the run, per year. |
| `fiscal_balance` | Fiscal balance a year | R | higher | Tax revenue less government spending over the run, per year. |

## Safety

| Id | Indicator | Unit | Better | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `incidents_per_1000` | Incidents per 1,000 a year | ‰ | lower | Crimes, intrusions and other incidents per 1,000 person-years. |
